name: Fictional customer - issue planning sample

sdlc.current: Planning sometimes starts before the issue's requirements and constraints are confirmed.
sdlc.desired: Clarify the issue through questions first, then turn only the approved scope into an execution plan.

glossary.brief: A draft capturing the goal, scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria confirmed from the issue
glossary.plan: An execution plan covering the implementation files, verification method, and stop conditions

pains.description: Unclear issues cause rework during implementation.
pains.impact: The plan and implementation scope keep changing.
pains.frequency: Fictional example; the real frequency is not verified.

success_criteria: Do not finalize a plan from an unapproved brief.
Each plan item traces to a confirmed issue requirement.
constraints: This is fictional customer information; real tool access and permissions are not verified.
This sample does not perform implementation, publishing, or deployment.

facts.statement: The sample content is fictional material used to illustrate product behavior.
facts.evidence: Development fixture included in the repository

assumptions: At run time the issue body is provided or approved local reads are available.
unknowns: The real customer's issue format, repository path, and approvers are not verified.
